annotation.authors_or_issuer: Ministry of Digital Development and Information (MDDI), Singapore
key_provisions_or_claims: New AI Visiting Professorship to attract world-class AI researchers to Singapore
Pilot batch of five AI Visiting Professors over next few years
Professors must spend at least 20% of their time on the collaboration
Must identify a Singapore collaborator and are encouraged to supervise local junior researchers
Aligned with national AI research agenda
annotation.summary_en: Singapore MDDI/MCI press release announcing a new AI Visiting Professorship to attract top international AI researchers, with a pilot of five professors who must spend at least 20% of their time collaborating with a local partner. It is an innovation-promotion measure, not regulation.
annotation.title_clean: Artificial Intelligence (AI) initiatives launched to uplift Singapore's economic potential
